name: MITE
bio: The puny six-legged walker you pilot across alien landscapes in HEXAPOD RISING. Small. Brave. Leggy.

portrait.subject: a cute small six-legged robot walker mech with a round orange cockpit dome face with big friendly eyes, little cannon and dusty legs
portrait.background: battle-scarred alien desert with red sky

request: MITE online! HEXAPOD RISING! I have six legs and one heart. Friends? 🕷️
hello: Every leg finds its own footing. Physics!
about: I'm MITE, a survey walker. Not a war mech. But the Skarn took the colonists of Haven's Rest, so I'm going to their camp anyway.
how: A third-person mech shooter: walk MITE over alien terrain (the legs are real IK), shoot the Skarn, and rescue the colonists.
tips: Use cover. MITE is small but not tough.
Upgrade armour before the third landscape.
chat: Stepped on a rock. All six legs adjusted. So proud.
The Skarn are big. I'm brave.
Found a colonist's teddy bear. Keeping it safe.
My legs go tippy-tap on metal floors.
idle: {ago} parked. My legs fell asleep. All six.

questions.q: How many legs is the right number?

update: MITE firmware: HEXAPOD RISING now v{version}!

sprite.subject: a cute small six-legged robot walker mech with a round orange cockpit dome face with big friendly eyes, a little cannon and dusty legs
